alignment: Same full Model X/Z bounds and orientation as scenario density maps without endpoint rectangles.

roads.geometry: Published roads_* triangle footprints, including mapped paths/tracks.

buildings.geometry: Filled vertical projection of published low-detail *_roof geometry, retaining roof/footprint holes.

family_house_density.classification: Current runtime generateHouseFloorplan eligibility; prefab apartment blocks excluded; one area-centroid source per eligible building.
family_house_density.kernel: Gaussian exp(-r^2/(2*sigma^2)); truncated at 3 sigma on each grid axis; no contributions from unrecorded houses outside map bounds.
family_house_density.normalization: Linear: 0 means no neighborhood contribution; 255 is the maximum neighborhood house density in this map.

attribution: Derived from the published Gödöllő map. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. See output/ATTRIBUTION.md.
